purpose: Combat BiS polish pack C — boss geography edges. First-class boss:* hubs missing from bis-boss-drops (20 hubs) + residual item densify. Skips every existing boss:* id in regional-combat-unlocks.json. Not strategy. Not rates. Not Waiko.

policy.duplicate_guard: Skip all existing boss:* hubs (vorago, telos, gwd1/nex, nex-angel-of-death/AoD, sanctum-of-rebirth, amascut, solak, raksha, araxxor, rasial, kerapac, arch-glacor, croesus, tzkal-zuk, zamorak-lord-of-chaos, gwd2, ed1-temple-of-aminishi, ed2-dragonkin-laboratory, ed3-shadow-reef, legiones). This pack only emits MISSING boss geography edges.
policy.region_rule: required_regions = hard Equilibrium elective self-supply. Wiki Equilibrium League badges preferred when present. Wilderness → forinthry. Mazcab = desert. Arc / Seiryu / ED1 = asgarnia (user rule 2026-07-26; optional Desert Ports pressure later).
policy.bis_rule: effects = BiS / near-BiS uniques that make the boss region-defining. Item ladder rows already first-class (desert:drygore-weapons, asgarnia:royal-crossbow, morytania:malevolent-armour, desert:magister-combat-hub, forinthry:corporeal-beast-holy-elixir) stay; this pack pins the boss geography hub they hang from.
